changelog.name: v1.2.7: Full Screen Immersive Fix
changelog.body:
### Changes
- Fixed a bug where the app was heavily letterboxed (huge black area at the bottom) on 20:9 screens because modern aspect ratios were not explicitly supported.
- Implemented automated version bumping in the build script.
- Modernized the bottom layout into a Material-like floating dock.

changelog.name: v1.2.4: UI Overhaul & Version Bump
changelog.body:
### Changes
- Fixed version code tracking causing '1.2.2' to show up
- Redesigned bottom action bar into a floating translucent dock
- Fixed layout overlapping behind the LSPosed alert banner
- Integrated the app logo directly into the header UI

changelog.name: v1.2.2: Bugfixes & Polish
changelog.body:
### Changes
- Implemented edge-to-edge immersive UI with proper WindowInsets padding
- Created proper Adaptive Icon for Android 8+ devices
- Fixed bug where toggling switches wouldn't remove hooks due to XSharedPreferences cache issues (migrated to PrefProvider IPC sync)
- Fixed bug where 50MP mode would attempt to inject unsupported 8192x6144 sizes into the front selfie camera

changelog.name: CameraTools v1.1.0
changelog.body:
﻿## 🎬 CameraTools v1.1.0 Release Notes

### 🚀 What's New in v1.1.0:
- **Dual Video (Director Mode / Mode 204) UNLOCKED & FULLY WORKING**:
  - Unlocked simultaneous front (OV16A1Q) + rear (Sony IMX766) multi-camera concurrent streaming and recording on Redmi Note 12 Pro 5G (ruby / MediaTek Dimensity 1080 MT6877).
  - Bypassed HAL multi-camera restrictions (onValidateOpenLocked return bypass and max concurrent stream bump).
  - Fixed MediaTek session operating mode (rewriting vendor Qualcomm session types 0x9005 to standard Android SESSION_REGULAR).
  - Added hooks for DualVideoModuleUtil, ComponentRunningDualVideo, and Checker hardware bypass.
  - Cleaned up debug method tracing for optimal camera responsiveness.
- **Modernized Dashboard UI & Verified Package Structure**:
  - Full OLED-dark UI dashboard with per-feature colored pill badges, haptic feedback, and smart Enable/Disable All toggle.
  - Updated verified module ID to `io.github.official_arvind.cameratools`.

### 🌟 All Features Included:
1. **4K 60FPS Video Recording**: Unlocks true 3840x2160 @ 60 FPS recording with 60 FPS toggle switch.
2. **Cinematic Ultra Bitrate (150 Mbps)**: Boosts 4K video recording up to 150 Mbps HEVC for studio master quality.
3. **50MP Full Bayer RAW (DNG)**: Enables true 50-megapixel uncompressed RAW sensor capture in Pro Mode.
4. **Leica Authentic & Vibrant Profiles + Branded Watermark**: Injects official Leica color profiles and branding.
5. **Dual-Camera Concurrent Stream (Director Mode)**: Full concurrent front + rear recording.
6. **Extended Pro Exposure Range**: 60s long exposure astrophotography down to 1/16000s shutter.
7. **Complete Thermal Warning & Shutdown Bypass**: Prevents camera close dialogs or recording halts under high temperature.

**Package:** io.github.official_arvind.cameratools  
**Version Code:** 101  
**Version Name:** 1.1.0

readme:
A powerful but simple Xposed module that unlocks hidden camera features on the Xiaomi Redmi Note 12 Pro 5G (ruby).

## About this module Xiaomi software restricts many camera capabilities on mid-range devices. This module bypasses these artificial restrictions by directly hooking into the Xiaomi Camera application at runtime. Enabling the module allows you to cleanly toggle hidden features without modifying your system files. You can turn on each feature from the CameraTools app, and a toast will confirm if the hook was successful when the Camera app opens. > [!NOTE] > Designed specifically for the **Redmi Note 12 Pro 5G (ruby)** running Xiaomi HyperOS or MIUI. While some features may work on other MediaTek Dimensity devices, this module targets the MT6877 camera capabilities. *(For developers wanting to see the technical reverse-engineering notes, please check our ruby reverse engineering repository.)* ## Features - **4K 60FPS Video Recording**: Unlocks smooth 4K video recording at 60 frames per second. - **Ultra High Video Quality**: Improves video recording quality (150 Mbps bitrate) for clearer videos without compression artifacts. - **50MP RAW Photos**: Enables uncompressed 50-megapixel RAW photos in Pro Mode. - **50MP Normal Photo**: Forces the standard Photo mode to take full 50-megapixel pictures automatically instead of pixel-binning to 12MP. - **Leica Camera Modes**: Adds Leica Authentic and Leica Vibrant camera modes and the official Leica watermark. - **Dual-Camera Video**: Record video using the front and rear cameras at the same time. - **Pro Mode Long Exposure**: Allows taking very long exposure photos (up to 60 seconds) in Pro Mode for astrophotography. - **Disable Overheating Limits**: Stops the camera from closing automatically when the phone gets warm during long video recording sessions. ## Requirements - Rooted device running Android 13+ (MIUI / HyperOS) - LSPosed (or compatible framework like Vector) installed and active ## Install 1. Install APK from [Releases](../../releases) 2. Enable the module in your Xposed manager and ensure the **Camera** (com.android.camera) app is checked in the scope. 3. Reboot your device (or force-stop the camera if your framework supports hot reload). 4. Open the CameraTools app and toggle your desired features. 5. Tap **Restart Camera** inside the app to apply changes immediately. ## Reporting issues If a feature fails to hook or crashes your camera, please create a [GitHub issue](https://github.com/official-Arvind/CameraTools/issues/new) and attach your LSPosed/Vector logs as well as a crash log (db logcat -b crash). ## License [![GPL-3.0-only](https://img.shields.io/badge/LICENSE-GPL--3.0--only-%23A42E2B?style=for-the-badge&logo=gnu&logoColor=white&logoPosition=right)](LICENSE)
